families.label: Measurement
families.description: Count and measure entities in the drawing.

capabilities.name: count-by-layer
capabilities.description: Counts every model-space entity per layer.

capabilities.name: measure-panel-area
capabilities.description: Sums closed-polyline area (total + per layer) in square feet; assumes 1 drawing unit = 1 inch.

families.label: Selection & highlighting
families.description: Select or highlight entities matching spatial criteria.

capabilities.name: highlight-panels-near-edge
capabilities.description: Returns handles of polylines on a layer whose centroid is within a distance of the drawing extents edge.

distance.description: Max distance (drawing units / inches) from an extents edge.

families.label: Custom authored tools
families.description: Tools authored in this workspace via /api/author.

capabilities.name: string-panels
capabilities.description: Bank-clustered, rotation-aware serpentine DC string routing over the Panels layer with an NEC 690.7 cold-temperature string-size check.

voc.description: Module open-circuit voltage at STC, volts (demo default).

design_min_temp_c.description: Design minimum ambient temperature, degC (demo default).

max_system_voltage.description: NEC 690.7 maximum system voltage, volts (commercial-rooftop demo default).

panel_layer.description: Intake layer carrying the closed panel polylines.

cluster_radius_factor.description: Bank clustering radius as a multiple of the median nearest-neighbor panel distance; strings never cross bank gaps.

capabilities.name: instant-list-layers
capabilities.description: Lists layers from the drawing context preloaded when the session opens.

capabilities.name: delete-marked-panel
capabilities.description: Deletes one marked panel polyline (by handle; default = first on layer Panels) and adds a marker entity — produces a new immutable drawing version.

drawing_id.description: Target drawing in the versioned store (well-known demo id at APS_LIVE=0).

handle.description: Handle of the polyline to delete; default = first polyline on `layer`.

layer.description: Layer to pick the default deletion target from.

families.label: Stringing
families.description: Panel-to-inverter string layout and target-count solving. Two names, one capability (operator ruling R-A, 2026-07-22): the heuristic autofill-string-targets and the real optimizer string-autofill-opt.

capabilities.name: string-autofill-opt
capabilities.description: Runs the existing AutoFill target solver and records deterministic input/result hashes and source revision.

capabilities.name: solar-solve-proposal
capabilities.description: Leaf Automation cloud stringer proposal. Provisional wire schema; never changes the drawing.

capabilities.name: autofill-string-targets
capabilities.description: Derive string targets from the drawing's panel polylines: bank-clustered, rotation-aware serpentine DC string routing over the Panels layer with an NEC 690.7 cold-temperature string-size check. Read-only; runs server/builtins/string_panels.py against the intake.

voc.description: Module open-circuit voltage at STC, volts (demo default).

design_min_temp_c.description: Design minimum ambient temperature, degC (demo default).

max_system_voltage.description: NEC 690.7 maximum system voltage, volts (commercial-rooftop demo default).

panel_layer.description: Intake layer carrying the closed panel polylines.

cluster_radius_factor.description: Bank clustering radius as a multiple of the median nearest-neighbor panel distance; strings never cross bank gaps.

capabilities.name: solar-settings
capabilities.description: Edit drawing-owned solar settings.

capabilities.name: solar-size-strings
capabilities.description: Confirm cloud string sizing for this drawing.

capabilities.name: solar-panel-groups
capabilities.description: Build panel groups with the licensed drawing engine.

capabilities.name: solar-commit-solve
capabilities.description: Commit a broker-validated solar solve candidate.

capabilities.name: solar-correct-string
capabilities.description: Correct persisted string membership or settings.

capabilities.name: solar-assign-equipment
capabilities.description: Place equipment and assign valid strings.

capabilities.name: solar-homeruns
capabilities.description: Route terminal leads for assigned strings.

capabilities.name: solar-schedule
capabilities.description: Create a circuit schedule from complete routing.

capabilities.name: solar-string-add
capabilities.description: Add one string over named panels, in the named order.

capabilities.name: solar-string-multi-add
capabilities.description: Split selected panels into strings: the MULTISTRING length combination cuts the panels, in the order given, into circuits of the target length and one shorter.

capabilities.name: solar-string-flip
capabilities.description: Reverse one string's panel order and trade its two ends; circuit and inverter stay.

capabilities.name: solar-string-midpoint
capabilities.description: Add one string along the shortest panel path between two picked panels of one group, tagged MID at its middle panel.

capabilities.name: solar-string-swap
capabilities.description: Exchange two strings' circuit identities (circuit tag and inverter input); panels stay where they are.

capabilities.name: solar-string-rebuild
capabilities.description: Rebuild every string's panel association (STRINGREBUILD, all) and report how many strings were rebuilt; the drawing is unchanged.

capabilities.name: solar-string-data
capabilities.description: Write StringData.json: every panel group sorted by name, with the selected strings whose two ends lie in it and their end coordinates.

capabilities.name: solar-string-delete
capabilities.description: Delete named strings from a solved drawing.

capabilities.name: solar-assign-strings
capabilities.description: Assign every unassigned string to the drawing's inverters or L1 collectors by the plugin's pattern matcher, numbering and tagging each circuit.

capabilities.name: solar-color-strings
capabilities.description: Colour every string by its inverter, as LEAFCOLORSTRINGS does: the untyped colour of its inverter number, colour 7 when unassigned.

capabilities.name: solar-string-conductors
capabilities.description: Set explicit conductor choices for named strings without certifying ampacity or voltage drop.

capabilities.name: solar-trackers-to-panel-groups
capabilities.description: Turn every tracker of the drawing's Ground layout into one panel group of module slots, as LEAFTRACKERSTOPANELGROUPS does, replacing any earlier conversion in one step.

families.label: Equipment placement
families.description: Provisional family for inverter/combiner placement tools. No member is registered in the catalog yet; entries below are reservations for the R2 registry-promotion lane.

capabilities.name: arlo-design
capabilities.description: Generate electrical feeder assembly proposals through the local ARLO design worker. Proposals require separate engineering review and native verification.

capabilities.name: solar-panels-from-drawing
capabilities.description: Create the drawing's panels from closed rectangular polylines on the panel layer.

capabilities.name: solar-select-by-zone
capabilities.description: List the panels of a named electrical zone, in the zone's stored order.

capabilities.name: solar-electrical-zones
capabilities.description: Add a named electrical zone, or assign panels to one, moving each panel out of any other zone.

capabilities.name: solar-elevation-zones
capabilities.description: Add rooftop elevation (height) zones with an offset, or move every matching panel, or every string, into one zone.

capabilities.name: solar-panel-add
capabilities.description: Add named panels to one panel group.

capabilities.name: solar-panel-remove
capabilities.description: Remove named panels from one panel group.

capabilities.name: solar-panel-group-delete
capabilities.description: Delete every panel group; the panels stay and leave their groups.

capabilities.name: solar-autofill-plan
capabilities.description: Preview the auto-fill correction plan for the current panel groups, ready to apply with solar-autofill.

capabilities.name: solar-autofill
capabilities.description: Apply an auto-fill correction plan that rebalances panel group membership, or revert exactly that plan.

capabilities.name: solar-guardrails-read
capabilities.description: Run the plugin's 14 design guardrails on the stored design: verdicts in palette order and the health banner counts.

capabilities.name: solar-unit-sync
capabilities.description: Declare the drawing's distance unit as Meters or Feet; no geometry moves.

capabilities.name: solar-design-presets
capabilities.description: Create, swap or delete the drawing's design presets (LEAFPROFILE); each preset keeps a copy of the drawing's 60 preset settings.

capabilities.name: solar-design-presets-list
capabilities.description: List the drawing's design presets (LEAFPROFILE List): each preset's name, prefix and settings, and which one is active.

capabilities.name: solar-equipment-move
capabilities.description: Move one inverter or collector to a picked point and reroute its homeruns there, as MOVEINV does; feeders stay where they are and go stale.

capabilities.name: solar-combiners
capabilities.description: Place combiner boxes for every string from the drawing's recorded combiner intake, as LEAFCOMBINERAUTO does, and save them with their DC homeruns and feeders in one step.

capabilities.name: solar-nec-ampacity-correction
capabilities.description: NEC 310.16 conductor ampacity with temperature and conduit-fill correction, as a cited calculation.

capabilities.name: solar-nec-ac-voltage-drop
capabilities.description: NEC 210.19(A)(4) AC voltage drop with reactance, power factor and phase factor, as a cited calculation.

capabilities.name: solar-nec-conduit-fill
capabilities.description: NEC Chapter 9 conduit fill: the smallest trade size for N conductors of one gauge plus an optional bare EGC, with Table 1, 4 and 5 values.

capabilities.name: solar-nec-feeder-ocpd
capabilities.description: NEC 215.3 and 210.20(A) feeder overcurrent device rating with its NEC 250.122 equipment grounding conductor, as a cited calculation.

capabilities.name: solar-trench-manual
capabilities.description: Route one trench between two picked points, or re-route a trench and mark the routes riding it out of date.

capabilities.name: solar-electrical-schedules
capabilities.description: Write ElectricalSchedules.json: the plugin's equipment, combiner or inverter, string and feeder schedule tables for the stored design.

capabilities.name: solar-cable-export
capabilities.description: Write CableExport.xlsx: the plugin's Export All workbook (homeruns, equipment, inverter, string and feeder sheets) for the stored design.

capabilities.name: solar-solaredge-accept
capabilities.description: Accept a SolarEdge report's tracking: record which PDF inverter and string input each panel belongs to, with the source PDF and report it came from. Creates no string, inverter or device and does not run Solve.

capabilities.name: solar-solaredge-tracking-read
capabilities.description: Show the accepted SolarEdge tracking: which PDF inverter and string input each panel was labelled with, the PDF and report it came from, and whether those panels still match the drawing. Labels only; no electrical design.
